title: Staff Management
subtitle: Manage manager and receptionist accounts, reset passwords, and assign property permissions.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone, or email...

table.name: Staff Member
table.noStaffSub: Add your first manager or receptionist to get started.

actions.confirmDeactivate: Are you sure you want to deactivate {name}? They will lose access to the portal immediately.
actions.confirmActivate: Are you sure you want to reactivate {name}?

modal.createSubtitle: Create an account for a manager or receptionist.
modal.emailHelp: Optional for staff. If provided, they can also sign in via email once verified.
modal.passwordHelp: If left blank, an invitation email will be sent (requires email address).
modal.resetSubtitle: Set a new password for {name}. All active sessions will be terminated immediately.
modal.passwordAlertBody: This password will only be shown once. Share it securely with the staff member.
modal.roleChangeHelp: Changing the role resets this person's module access to the new role's defaults.
modal.noProperties: No properties found. Add a property first.
modal.propertiesHelp: Owners always have access to every property. A Manager or Receptionist only sees properties checked here.

errors.phoneRequired: Phone number is required for staff
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number (starting with 6-9)
errors.passwordOrEmailRequired: At least one of password or email is required
errors.phoneTaken: This phone number is already active for another account
errors.emailTaken: This email address is already active for another account
errors.genericError: Failed to complete request. Please try again.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.hint: Shows the dashboard screen. Each card still follows its own module's access.

properties.name: Properties
properties.hint: Full access includes rooms, beds and property settings (late fees, penalties). View only keeps property features read-only.

tenants.name: Tenants
tenants.hint: Full access includes admissions, allocations and move-out with deposit settlement. Billing figures follow the Finance module.

finance.name: Finance
finance.hint: View only shows invoices, payments and rent figures. Full access can also create and change them.

expenses.name: Expenses
expenses.hint: View only shows the PG's expenses and their totals. Full access can also record, edit and delete them.

complaints.name: Complaints
complaints.hint: View, assign and resolve resident complaints.

access.saveFailed: Couldn't save that change, so it was reverted.
access.roleChangedNotice: This staff member's role changed, so their access was reloaded.
access.notFoundBody: This person doesn't exist or isn't part of your team.
access.inactiveBanner: This account is deactivated. You can still adjust access; it applies when they are reactivated.
access.applyNote: Changes are enforced by the server immediately. The staff member’s screen updates the next time they open or refocus the app.
